summary:
LIFESIGNAL – AI-Powered Search for the Ingredients of Life

LIFESIGNAL is an AI-powered astronomical research project designed to explore the chemical ingredients necessary for life beyond Earth. Using NASA's SPHEREx mission data, our project aims to investigate infrared observations and identify potential signatures of life-related molecules, including water and other important chemical compounds.

We have developed an initial Python-based data collection system that retrieves SPHEREx observations and saves the collected information in CSV format. Our planned platform will integrate astronomical data processing, spectral analysis, visualization, and AI-based pattern recognition.

LIFESIGNAL addresses the challenge of exploring whether environments beyond Earth contain the essential chemical ingredients associated with life. This project is important because understanding the distribution of these ingredients can help scientists identify promising regions for future astrobiological research and bring us closer to answering one of humanity's biggest questions: Are we alone in the universe?
details:
Project Details

Our project focuses on analysing astronomical data from NASA's SPHEREx (Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization and Ices Explorer) mission. The project aims to explore and understand the universe by studying the spectral information collected from celestial objects.

The system works by processing and analysing SPHEREx datasets to identify meaningful patterns and extract useful astronomical information. It can help researchers understand galaxies, stars, cosmic structures, and the distribution of matter across the universe.

Benefits: The project makes astronomical data easier to explore, understand, and interpret. It supports scientific research and helps transform large volumes of observational data into meaningful insights.

Intended Impact: The project aims to contribute to our understanding of the universe and demonstrate how data analysis and computational techniques can support space science.

Creativity and Innovation: The project combines space science, data analysis, and technology to make complex astronomical information more accessible and useful.

Development Considerations: Data accuracy, dataset reliability, processing efficiency, scientific relevance, and the clarity of the results were important factors considered during development.
